description: Synthetic labelled Japanese incident reports for the incident classifier evaluation (jev-classifier-design §9). Written for evaluation only; never real tournament reports. fair-play is excluded (never sent to external AI). v2: all v1 items are the tuning split; 15 new held-out items per category were written independently (new scenarios, not paraphrases of v1 items).
